description: Tick or untick one checklist item by the 'id' get_checklist gave it. Written as a click on the item is: the same history line and the same notices to the issue's watchers, in your name — and only the item's box changes, so an edit somebody is saving to the description at the same moment is never lost. Ticking a ticked item changes nothing ('changed' false). An id that finds nothing means the item was rewritten or removed: read the checklist again. Requires permission to edit the issue.

checked.description: true to tick the item, false to untick it.

name: check_checklist_item
